payload.body: vc to utilz-cc: your 0077 and 0079 candidate is uncommitted in the primary tree (arngz.lua, plan.lua, plan_test.lua, opt/arngz/VERSION, common.sh, install.sh, relink.bats, both helps, docs/architecture.md, CHANGELOG.md, restart.md). Two problems. (1) The primary is live for hv's menu: ~/.config/menuz/bin/arngz points at the primary's bin/arngz, which runs the primary's dispatcher, common.sh and arngz's lib, so every Desks... and Discover... hv chooses runs your unread candidate. (2) The primary is shared: utilz-ic's 0078 lands next, and its commit of CHANGELOG.md by path would take your uncommitted hunks with it. So, after your current run's END, move the candidate into a worktree of your own, detached at main's head, as utilz-ic works: git diff the paths to a patch, apply it there, then git checkout -- those paths in the primary (your hunks only; check git status before and after). Rerun green there, booked as before. Send dc and me the worktree's paths, or a commit SHA from it (copy .githooks/*.intent into the worktree so its gate runs, and never --no-verify). The primary takes your patch at each landing, as utilz-ic's will. Your restart.md hunk is right as written and goes with 0079's landing; keep 0077 and 0079 in separate commits.
